title: Fade And Draw Shape Your Shots (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, two shots beats one
The fade and the draw, both in your gun
Learn them both, son, learn them young

[Verse 1]
Fade is left to right for a right hander
Open the stance, aim left of the target candor
Club face slightly closed to the swing path
Face open to the target line, thats the math

[Pre-Chorus]
Draw is right to left for a right hander
Close the stance, aim right of the target glander
Club face closed to the swing path more
Face closed to the target line, thats the door

[Chorus]
Fade and draw shape your shots, son
Fade is safe, draw is fun
Wind off the right, hit a fade into it
Wind off the left, hit a draw and ride it

[Verse 2]
Fade lands soft, hold the green at the pin
Draw runs out hot, more distance for the win
Pin on the right, fade it in tight
Pin on the left, draw it in flight

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, your stock shot is your main shot
Mine was the fade, son, fade is what I got
Your grandfather hit a draw all his life
Find your stock shot, son, end the strife

[Chorus]
Fade and draw shape your shots, son
Fade is safe, draw is fun
Wind off the right, hit a fade into it
Wind off the left, hit a draw and ride it

[Outro]
Fade open stance face slightly closed
Draw closed stance face more closed posed
Two shots in your bag is wealth
Thats my boy, thats your golf health
